definitions.explanation: A salary that remains the same each month regardless of performance or hours worked. Contrasted with performance-based or commission-based pay.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{固定|こてい}{給|きゅう}です。
examples.english: This company pays a fixed salary.

examples.japanese: {固定|こてい}{給|きゅう}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧。
examples.english: It's tough to get by on the base salary alone.

examples.japanese: {固定|こてい}{給|きゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加|くわ}えて→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧⟦{業績|ぎょうせき}→業績：04873_gyouseki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|おう}じた→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧⟦ボーナス→ボーナス：05878_boonasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{支給|しきゅう}→支給：02835_shikyuu⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In addition to the fixed salary, bonuses are paid based on performance.

notes:
USAGE:
Common in discussions about compensation structures, job listings, and employment conditions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {固定|こてい}{給|きゅう}+⟦{歩合|ぶあい}{制|せい}→歩合制：08089_buaisei⟧ (fixed salary plus commission)
- {固定|こてい}{給|きゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧／⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧ (fixed salary is high/low)
- {固定|こてい}{給|きゅう}⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧ (fixed salary system)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{基本給|きほんきゅう}→基本給：21335_kihonkyuu⟧: base pay — the core pay before allowances; may still vary
- ⟦{歩合給|ぶあいきゅう}→歩合給：22050_buaikyuu⟧: commission-based pay — varies with performance or sales
- ⟦{年俸|ねんぽう}→年俸：19672_nenpou⟧: annual salary — total pay calculated per year
